title: SAFIRE: Safety-Critical Benchmark for Fine-grained Fire and Smoke Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.07823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong progress on vision-language tasks, yet their reliability in safety-critical settings remains underexplored. Fire-smoke understanding is central to public safety and disaster response, but most existing benchmarks lack diverse real-world scenarios and context-aware evaluation. We introduce SAFIRE, a large-scale benchmark for fire-smoke understanding in MLLMs, comprising 83K captioned images from 20 scenarios and 193K multiple-choice VQA (MCVQA) generated from a 9.7K-image subset, spanning 10 evaluation dimensions from basic perception to higher-order reasoning. A GPT-5.4-assisted multi-stage verification pipeline with MLLM majority voting ensures annotation quality. Evaluating ten open-source MLLMs (8B-38B) yields an average accuracy of 61.9%, exposing major gaps in safety-critical reasoning. We further show that adapting vision encoders with only 7% of our domain-specific data boosts

translated_title: SAFIRE：面向多模态大语言模型细粒度火焰与烟雾理解的安全关键型基准
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉-语言任务上展现出强大进展，但其在安全关键场景中的可靠性仍缺乏充分研究。火焰烟雾理解对公共安全和灾害响应至关重要，但现有的大多数基准缺乏多样化的真实世界场景和上下文感知评估。我们提出了SAFIRE，一个面向多模态大语言模型火焰烟雾理解的大规模基准，包含来自20个场景的83K张带标注图像，以及基于9.7K图像子集生成的193K道多项选择视觉问答（MCVQA）题目，涵盖从基础感知到高阶推理的10个评估维度。通过GPT-5.4辅助的多阶段验证流程结合多模态大语言模型多数投票机制，确保了标注质量。对十个开源多模态大语言模型（8B-38B）的评估显示平均准确率仅为61.9%，暴露出安全关键推理方面的重大缺陷。我们进一步表明，仅使用领域特定数据中7%的数据对视觉编码器进行适配即可显著提升性能（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了SAFIRE大规模火焰烟雾理解基准，包含83K张图像和193K道多项选择问答，评估显示当前多模态大模型在安全关键推理上平均准确率仅61.9%，且仅用7%的领域数据微调视觉编码器即可显著提升性能。
